name: Minds 7: hoarding against how often owners find their own caches
description: The mean L among the hoarders of generation 50 (hoarder_larder_prob; window_mean, ticks 98001–100000) in hoard-threshold's world (ratio 0.22, the paper's 50 % point) against owner_recovery, the chance an owner finds one of its own scattered caches when it looks: 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 or 1 (the paper's free recall). The run is 50 of the 60 generations because sweeps stop at 100 000 ticks. Ten seeds; the survey does more.
